words.engDef: short for absolute value; also the stomach muscles
words.example: The company reported a significant increase in absolute sales figures for the quarter.
words.chinese: 絕對值；總數

words.engDef: on the opposite side of the road
words.example: The office building is located across the street from the train station.
words.chinese: 在...的對街；位於...的另一側

words.engDef: an extra charge on top of the usual price
words.example: Please note that there may be an additional fee for express shipping.
words.chinese: 額外費用；附加費用（通常指超出基本價格的額外收費）

words.engDef: to move a mirror to the right angle
words.example: Before driving, please adjust the mirror to ensure optimal visibility.
words.chinese: 調整鏡子，通常指調整車輛後視鏡或化妝鏡等。

words.engDef: the price of a ticket to travel by air
words.example: The company will reimburse employees for their airfare and accommodation expenses.
words.chinese: 機票費用；航空票價

words.engDef: companies that carry passengers by air
words.example: Several airlines have announced fare reductions for the upcoming holiday season.
words.chinese: 航空公司；航空業

words.engDef: places where aircraft take off and land

words.chinese: 機場，通常指國際或國內航空運輸的樞紐。

words.engDef: the feeling of nausea some people get when flying
words.example: The airline offers complimentary ginger ale to passengers suffering from airsickness.
words.chinese: 暈機症，飛行時因身體不適而產生的噁心或不舒服的感覺。

words.engDef: a seat next to the passage in a plane or theatre
words.example: I prefer an aisle seat so I can easily get up to use the restroom.
words.chinese: 機上座位，位於機艙走道旁，方便乘客進出。

words.engDef: beside the edge of the sea or a lake
words.example: The resort is located along the shore, offering stunning ocean views.
words.chinese: 沿著海岸線

words.engDef: desirable or useful features of a building, hotel, or place
words.example: The luxury resort is famous for its exceptional spa and fitness amenities.
words.chinese: （飯店）便利設施，備品

words.engDef: an outdoor place with rides and entertainment
words.example: Our company is considering offering employee discounts to local amusement parks as a team-building activity.
words.chinese: 遊樂園，通常提供各種娛樂設施和活動，吸引遊客。

words.engDef: an island country in the Caribbean
words.example: The hotel boasts an antigua facade, blending seamlessly with the historic district.
words.chinese: 古老的；歷史悠久的（通常指建築、文物等）

words.engDef: the fourth month of the year
words.example: The company's annual sales conference is scheduled for April next year.
words.chinese: 四月，一年中的第四個月。

words.engDef: the sport of shooting with a bow and arrows
words.example: The company is considering offering archery as a team-building activity for employees.
words.chinese: 箭術；射箭

words.engDef: a place name, also a volcano in Costa Rica

words.chinese: （火山）沙灘；由火山灰或熔岩碎屑形成的沙灘

words.engDef: reached a place at the end of a journey

words.chinese: 抵達；到達

words.engDef: reaching a place at the end of a journey
words.example: The flight is arriving at Gate 12 on time.
words.chinese: 抵達；到達（指人或物）

words.engDef: a building where works of art are displayed
words.example: Our company is planning a corporate event at the art museum next month.
words.chinese: 藝術博物館，通常展示和保存藝術作品，是企業活動中文化交流或商務接待的場所。

words.engDef: a large city in the south-eastern United States
words.example: Our company is considering relocating its headquarters to Atlanta due to its favorable business climate.
words.chinese: 亞特蘭大（美國喬治亞州最大城市，也是重要的商業中心）

words.engDef: places that people enjoy visiting
words.example: The city's main attractions include historical landmarks and vibrant cultural events.
words.chinese: 景點、吸引力（指吸引遊客或投資者的事物）

words.engDef: a car
words.example: The company provides employees with a vehicle allowance to cover the cost of their automobiles.
words.chinese: 汽車；機動車（通常指乘用車，在商務情境中指個人或公司擁有的車輛）

words.engDef: a business that repairs cars
words.example: Our company has a contract with a local automotive repair shop for vehicle maintenance.
words.chinese: 汽車維修店，提供汽車保養、維修及相關服務的商業場所。

words.engDef: the seat at the rear of a car
words.example: The passengers in the backseat were enjoying the scenic route.
words.chinese: 後座（通常指車輛後座）；不重要的角色或意見

words.engDef: the area in an airport where arriving passengers collect luggage
words.example: The travelers proceeded to the baggage claim area after passing customs.
words.chinese: 行李提領處

words.engDef: a city in California
words.example: Our logistics team is coordinating shipments to Bakersfield and surrounding areas.
words.chinese: 巴克司菲爾德（加州），一個位於加州中央山谷的城市，常被用於指代該地區。

words.engDef: a large city in Spain
words.example: Our company is considering Barcelona as a potential location for our next international conference.
words.chinese: 巴塞隆納（西班牙城市），通常指位於西班牙的巴塞隆納市，在商務情境中可指該市的商業活動、會議地點或旅遊目的地。

words.engDef: a slow-moving stream in a marshy area
words.example: The company is considering a scenic tour along the bayou to attract tourists.
words.chinese: 沼澤；河口三角洲地區的寬闊水路，通常指美國南部路易斯安那州等地的水路。

words.engDef: to have no places or times left available
words.example: I'm sorry, sir, but the conference room is booked up for the entire week.
words.chinese: 已滿額；預訂額滿，無法安排

words.engDef: to be shut so that vehicles cannot pass
words.example: Due to the marathon, Main Street will be closed to traffic from 7 AM to 12 PM.
words.chinese: 因施工或活動等原因，對車輛交通限制或禁止通行。

words.engDef: to be delayed
words.example: The flight was held up due to severe weather conditions.
words.chinese: 因故延遲；被耽擱

words.engDef: to be delayed because of heavy traffic
words.example: I'm sorry for the delay; I was held up in traffic this morning.
words.chinese: 因交通延誤而耽擱；因塞車而停滯

words.engDef: to be waiting in a queue
words.example: Please be in line at the security checkpoint to ensure a smooth boarding process.
words.chinese: 排隊等候；在隊伍中

words.engDef: to be away travelling
words.example: Mr. Lee is on a business trip to Tokyo next week to negotiate a new contract.
words.chinese: 正在旅行；出差

words.engDef: to have your vehicle pulled away by an official truck
words.example: Your vehicle will be towed away if you park in a restricted zone.
words.chinese: 因違規停車而被拖吊

words.engDef: a country in western Europe
words.example: Our company is exploring potential partnerships with businesses in Belgium.
words.chinese: 比利時，一個位於歐洲的國家，在國際貿易和商業活動中經常被提及。

words.engDef: the capital city of Germany
words.example: Our company is considering opening a new branch in Berlin to expand our European market.
words.chinese: 柏林，德國首都，也是重要的商業和文化中心。

words.engDef: two-wheeled vehicles that you pedal
words.example: The company is offering a discount on bicycles to encourage employees to commute sustainably.
words.chinese: 腳踏車；自行車（多輛）

words.engDef: bicycles or motorcycles
words.example: The company is offering a bike-sharing program for employees to reduce their carbon footprint.
words.chinese: 腳踏車（複數）；自行車

words.engDef: riding a bicycle
words.example: Many employees are encouraged to bike to work to reduce traffic congestion and promote a healthier lifestyle.
words.chinese: 騎自行車；騎腳踏車（作為一種通勤或休閒活動）

words.engDef: an instrument with two eyepieces for seeing distant things
words.example: The tour guide recommended bringing binoculars to better observe the wildlife during the safari.
words.chinese: 雙筒望遠鏡；觀景鏡

words.engDef: a district of London
words.example: The conference venue is located in Bloomsbury, known for its literary history and proximity to the British Museum.
words.chinese: 布盧姆斯伯里 (倫敦西區一個地區)，通常指該地區的文化、文學氛圍或其代表的波西米亞式生活方式。

words.engDef: to get on an aircraft
words.example: Passengers are requested to board the flight 30 minutes prior to departure.
words.chinese: 登上飛機；搭乘飛機

words.engDef: getting onto a plane, ship, or train
words.example: Passengers are requested to begin boarding the aircraft 30 minutes prior to departure.
words.chinese: 登機；（船隻）上船

words.engDef: the place in an airport where passengers get on a plane
words.example: Please proceed to boarding gate 42 for your flight to New York.
words.chinese: 登機口，指旅客在機場搭乘飛機的指定位置。

words.engDef: a pass that authorizes a passenger to board a plane or ship
words.example: Please show your boarding pass and national passport to the gate agent.
words.chinese: 登機證

words.engDef: the time at which passengers may get on a plane
words.example: Please arrive at the gate at least 30 minutes before your boarding time.
words.chinese: 登機時間，指旅客應在機場辦理登機手續並準備登機的時間。

words.engDef: an area of water such as a lake or sea
words.example: The company is exploring the possibility of transporting goods by water, utilizing the nearby body of water.
words.chinese: 水域，指廣闊的水體，例如湖泊、河流、海洋等。

words.engDef: reserved a seat, room, or ticket in advance
words.example: The conference room is already booked for the entire day.
words.chinese: 預訂；已訂位（通常指飯店、機票、會議室等）

words.engDef: a reservation made in advance
words.example: We need to confirm all flight bookings before the conference.
words.chinese: 預訂；訂位；（會議、活動等）安排

words.engDef: a large city in the north-eastern United States
words.example: Our company is considering opening a new branch office in Boston to tap into the local talent pool.
words.chinese: 波士頓，美國麻薩諸塞州的一座主要城市，也是商業、教育和科技中心。

words.engDef: a park where many kinds of plants are grown and studied
words.example: Our company is sponsoring a guided tour of the botanical garden for employees and their families.
words.chinese: 植物園，專門展示和研究各種植物的園區，通常用於教育、研究或休閒目的。

words.engDef: travelling towards a particular place
words.example: The shipment is bound for Singapore and is expected to arrive next week.
words.chinese: 正前往；駛向（某地）

words.engDef: a seaside city in southern England
words.example: The company is considering holding its annual conference in Brighton next year.
words.chinese: 布萊頓（英國城市名），通常指位於英國南海岸的度假城市，在商務情境中可能指該城市舉辦的會議、活動或其地理位置。

words.engDef: a city in south-west England
words.example: Our company is considering expanding its operations to Bristol, a major commercial hub in the UK.
words.chinese: 布里斯托 (英國城市名)，通常指位於英格蘭西南部的大城市，是英國重要的貿易港口。

words.engDef: to fasten your seatbelt
words.example: Before we start the journey, please buckle up your seatbelts.
words.chinese: 繫好安全帶（通常指汽車安全帶），以確保乘車安全。

words.engDef: small houses with only one storey
words.example: The resort offers a variety of accommodations, including luxurious bungalows with ocean views.
words.chinese: 獨棟小屋；度假小屋（通常指帶有花園或庭院的單層小屋，常在海邊或度假勝地使用）

words.engDef: a place where buses stop for passengers
words.example: The delivery driver needs to wait at the bus stop to pick up the package.
words.chinese: 公車站牌；公車停靠站

words.engDef: a large port city in South Korea
words.example: Our company is exploring opportunities to expand its operations into Busan.
words.chinese: 釜山（韓國城市名），通常指韓國第二大城市，在商務情境中可能指該地的商業活動或旅遊。

words.engDef: a class of air travel with better seats and service
words.example: The company policy allows employees to fly business class on international trips.
words.chinese: 商務艙，提供更寬敞的座位、額外服務和設施的飛機座位等級。

words.engDef: a road with a lot of traffic and people

words.chinese: 繁忙的街道，通常指交通繁忙、人潮眾多的街道。

words.engDef: a state on the west coast of the United States
words.example: Our company is expanding its operations into California to tap into the large market.
words.chinese: 加利福尼亞州，美國西海岸的一個州，常指位於美國西部的加州，在商業語境中可能指該州的商業活動、市場或地理位置。

words.engDef: staying in a tent or camper for a holiday
words.example: The company is offering a team-building event involving camping in the mountains.
words.chinese: 露營；野營

words.engDef: a large country in North America
words.example: Our company is exploring potential partnerships with businesses in Canada.
words.chinese: 加拿大，一個位於北美洲的國家，以其豐富的自然資源和多元文化而聞名，在國際貿易和商業活動中經常被提及。

words.engDef: the calling off of something that was arranged
words.example: Due to unforeseen circumstances, we regret to inform you of the flight cancellation.
words.chinese: 取消（預訂、合約等），取消通知

words.engDef: the business of hiring out cars for short periods
words.example: Our company offers discounted car rentals for business travelers.
words.chinese: 汽車租賃；租車服務

words.engDef: an arrangement where people share a car to travel
words.example: To reduce our carbon footprint, the company encourages employees to carpool to work.
words.chinese: 共乘；拼車（多數人共同使用同一輛車，以節省交通費用或減少環境污染）

words.engDef: the bag you take with you into the aircraft cabin
words.example: Please ensure your carry-on baggage meets the airline's size and weight restrictions.
words.chinese: 隨身行李，通常指符合航空公司規定尺寸且可放置於機艙內的手提行李。

words.engDef: road vehicles for carrying a small number of people
words.example: The company is considering purchasing a fleet of electric cars to reduce its carbon footprint.
words.chinese: 汽車；車輛（通常指多輛）

words.engDef: the name of an aircraft maker, used for small planes
words.example: The company is considering purchasing a Cessna for short-distance business travel.
words.chinese: 賽斯納（Cessna）是一家美國飛機製造商，通常指其製造的小型飛機。

words.engDef: the tubes joining a bicycle's frame to its rear wheel

words.chinese: 自行車的後上叉，連接車架後部與後輪。

words.engDef: an aircraft hired for a particular group or trip
words.example: The company arranged a charter plane to transport all employees to the conference in Hawaii.
words.chinese: 包機航班；為特定團體或公司租用的專用客機。

words.engDef: to report your arrival at a hotel or airport
words.example: Please check in at the front desk upon arrival.
words.chinese: （在飯店、機場等）辦理入住；（系統）登入

words.engDef: a city in north-west England
words.example: Our company is planning a sales conference in Chester next quarter.
words.chinese: （英格蘭）徹斯特（城市名），通常指英國徹斯特市，在商務情境中可能指該市的企業或活動。

words.engDef: a large city in the mid-western United States
words.example: Our company is opening a new branch office in Chicago next year.
words.chinese: 芝加哥（美國伊利諾州最大的城市，也是重要的商業中心）

words.engDef: a long narrow country on the west coast of South America
words.example: Our company is exploring potential trade partnerships with Chile.
words.chinese: 智利（一國），或指智利辣椒（一種香料）。在商務情境中，通常指國家。

words.engDef: a district of a city where many Chinese people live and trade
words.example: The company is considering opening a new branch in Chinatown to cater to the growing Asian market.
words.chinese: 唐人街，通常指在非華人地區的華人聚居區，以商業活動和中華文化為特色。

words.engDef: a circus; also a bowl-shaped hollow in a mountain
words.example: Our company is sponsoring a local cirque performance to boost employee morale.
words.chinese: 馬戲團；巡迴表演團體（通常以特技、雜耍和空中表演為特色）

words.engDef: large towns where many people live and work
words.example: Our company is expanding its operations into several major cities across Asia.
words.chinese: 城市；都市（指人口眾多、商業發達的聚居地）

words.engDef: states something is true; also requests for payment
words.example: The insurance company requires detailed documentation to support your claims.
words.chinese: 聲稱；主張；索賠

words.engDef: going up something such as a mountain or ladder
words.example: The company is climbing the ranks in the industry thanks to its innovative products.
words.chinese: 攀登；上升；(比喻)晉升

words.engDef: a state in the western United States
words.example: Our company is considering expanding its operations to Colorado due to its growing tech industry.
words.chinese: 科羅拉多州，美國的一個州，以其山脈、滑雪勝地和戶外活動而聞名，在商務情境中常指科羅拉多州的地理位置或相關產業。

words.engDef: a small car that is economical to run
words.example: Our company is considering purchasing a fleet of compact cars to reduce fuel costs.
words.chinese: 小型汽車，通常指車身尺寸較小、燃油效率較高的汽車。

words.engDef: a separate section inside a vehicle or container
words.example: Please store your carry-on luggage in the overhead compartment.
words.chinese: 隔間; (火車等的)小客房,小包廂; 艙; 箱

words.engDef: a hotel staff member who assists guests with bookings, reservations, and information
words.example: The hotel concierge helped us secure front-row tickets to the sold-out Broadway show.
words.chinese: （飯店）禮賓人員，服務台職員

words.engDef: a large open area in a station or airport
words.example: Passengers crowded the concourse, waiting for their delayed flights.
words.chinese: （車站、機場等）大廳、候客區；人群

words.engDef: too full of traffic or people to move easily
words.example: The highway is heavily congested during rush hour, so allow extra travel time.
words.chinese: 擁塞的；阻塞的，交通繁忙的

words.engDef: the state of being blocked by too much traffic
words.example: Due to heavy congestion on the highway, the delivery is expected to be delayed.
words.chinese: 交通擁塞；阻塞；（網路）擁塞

words.engDef: a second flight you take to reach your destination
words.example: Due to the flight cancellation, I had to book a connecting flight with a longer layover.
words.chinese: 轉機航班；中轉航班（指旅客需要換機才能到達最終目的地的航班）

words.engDef: a large wild cat found in the Americas
words.example: The tour guide warned the group to be cautious, as cougars are occasionally spotted in this region.
words.chinese: 美洲獅，一種大型貓科動物，通常指生活在北美洲的這種貓科動物。

words.engDef: hit something violently; also stopped working suddenly
words.example: The cargo plane crashed during the storm, resulting in significant delays.
words.chinese: 撞擊、墜毀（指交通工具或設備等突然且劇烈的撞擊，導致損壞或停止運作）

words.engDef: a French word for cross, used in place names
words.example: The delivery driver got lost and had trouble finding the correct intersection, or croix, on the map.
words.chinese: 十字架；交叉點（通常指交通路口或交叉路口）

words.engDef: to walk from one side of the road to the other
words.example: Please be careful when you cross the street; traffic is heavy during rush hour.
words.chinese: 穿越馬路；橫過馬路

words.engDef: the marked place where people may cross a road
words.example: Pedestrians must use the crosswalk when crossing the street to ensure their safety.
words.chinese: 行人穿越道，通常在道路上繪製的標線，用以確保行人安全穿越馬路。

words.engDef: full of too many people
words.example: The train was so crowded during the morning rush hour that passengers had to stand.
words.chinese: 擁擠的；人潮眾多的，形容空間或場所因人數過多而變得狹窄不適。

words.engDef: a person whose job is to help and deal with customers
words.example: Our company is hiring several customer service representatives to handle increased call volume.
words.chinese: 客戶服務代表，負責處理客戶諮詢、投訴及提供支援的專業人員。

words.engDef: a person who rides a bicycle
words.example: The company is promoting cycling to work as a sustainable transportation option for employees.
words.chinese: 自行車騎士；騎自行車的人

words.engDef: the horn of a deer, used as a place name
words.example: The souvenir shop sells handcrafted items featuring deerhorns and antlers.
words.chinese: 鹿角（複數）；指鹿角，通常用於描述自然景觀或野生動物相關的產品。

words.engDef: made to happen later than planned
words.example: The flight was delayed due to bad weather, causing inconvenience to passengers.
words.chinese: 延遲的；被延遲的

words.engDef: a female first name
words.example: The company appointed a delia to handle the legal proceedings.
words.chinese: 委託人；代理人（通常指在商業或法律事務中代表他人行事的人）

words.engDef: a city in the western United States
words.example: Our company is considering opening a new branch in Denver to tap into the growing market.
words.chinese: 丹佛（美國科羅拉多州的首府及最大城市）

words.engDef: leaving a place, especially to start a journey
words.example: The departing flight to London is scheduled for 7:00 AM.
words.chinese: 即將離開；啟程的

words.engDef: leaves a place to start a journey
words.example: The flight departs from Gate 12 at 10:00 AM.
words.chinese: 出發；離開

words.engDef: the time at which a vehicle leaves
words.example: Please confirm the departure time for flight BA249 to London.
words.chinese: 出發時間，指交通工具（如飛機、火車、巴士）預計離開的時刻。

words.engDef: the place someone or something is going to
words.example: Our company is expanding its operations and exploring new international destinations.
words.chinese: 目的地；目標地點

words.engDef: the places people are travelling to
words.example: The company is expanding its services to several new destinations in Asia.
words.chinese: 目的地；終點站（通常指旅行或運輸的目的地）

words.engDef: a longer route taken because the direct way is blocked

words.chinese: 萊比錫，德國東部城市，也是重要的商業和文化中心。

words.engDef: the registration number shown on a vehicle
words.example: The security guard asked for the license plate number of the vehicle involved in the accident.
words.chinese: 車牌號碼，通常用於識別車輛。

words.engDef: a ring or jacket that keeps a person afloat
words.example: The cruise line requires all passengers to familiarize themselves with the location of the life preservers.
words.chinese: 救生圈；救生浮標

words.engDef: a port city in north-west England
words.example: Our company is considering opening a new branch in Liverpool to tap into the local market.
words.chinese: 利物浦，英國城市，也是足球俱樂部利物浦足球隊的所在地，在商務場合常指該城市或其足球隊。

words.english: lock the key in the car
words.engDef: to shut the car with the key still inside
words.example: I accidentally locked the key in the car, and now I'm stranded.
words.chinese: 將鑰匙鎖在車內，導致無法進入車輛。

words.engDef: the capital city of the United Kingdom
words.example: Our company is opening a new branch office in London next quarter.
words.chinese: 倫敦，英國首都，也是重要的商業和金融中心。

words.engDef: a city in the north-eastern United States
words.example: Our company is considering expanding operations to Lowell, Massachusetts.
words.chinese: 洛厄爾（美國麻薩諸塞州城市名），通常指位於美國東部，曾是重要的工業城市。

words.engDef: the capital city of Spain
words.example: Our company is considering opening a new branch in Madrid to expand our European market.
words.chinese: 馬德里，西班牙首都，也是重要的商業中心。

words.engDef: relating to Madrid or its people
words.example: The hotel caters specifically to Madrileño guests and international tourists.
words.chinese: 形容詞，指來自或與馬德里（西班牙首都）相關的人或事物。

words.engDef: a tree with large sweet-smelling flowers
words.example: The hotel lobby was beautifully decorated with magnolias, creating a luxurious and welcoming atmosphere for guests.
words.chinese: 木蘭花，一種大型、常綠的開花樹木，其花朵通常用於裝飾或作為禮物。

words.engDef: to pause a journey at a place
words.example: We'll make a brief stop at the service station to refuel the vehicle.
words.chinese: 暫停；停留（通常指短暫的休息或為了特定目的而停下來）

words.engDef: a common wild duck
words.example: The eco-tourism package includes a guided tour of the wetlands, where you can observe mallards and other waterfowl.
words.chinese: 原野鴨（一種常見的鴨子種類，通常用於描述自然環境或生態系統，在商務情境中可能出現在與生態旅遊、環境保護相關的討論中）

words.engDef: relating to Malta; also a small white breed of dog
words.example: The hotel offers a pet-friendly policy, welcoming guests with their Maltese companions.
words.chinese: 馬爾他犬；（指）馬爾他語的

words.engDef: to move something skilfully into position
words.example: The truck driver skillfully maneuvered the vehicle through the narrow city streets.
words.chinese: 巧妙地操作或移動（通常指車輛或設備），以應對特定情況或達成目標。

words.engDef: the central district of New York City
words.example: Our company is relocating its headquarters to Manhattan next quarter.
words.chinese: 曼哈頓（紐約市的一個行政區，通常指該區的商業中心）

words.engDef: a city in Morocco
words.example: Our company is considering a team-building retreat in Marrakesh next quarter.
words.chinese: 馬拉喀什，摩洛哥的城市，常指該城市本身或其文化、風格。

words.engDef: the tall pole that holds a ship's sails
words.example: The ship's mast was damaged during the storm, delaying the cargo delivery.
words.chinese: 桅杆；船桅

words.engDef: relating to the ancient people of Central America
words.example: The company is planning a cultural tour to explore the Mayan ruins in Guatemala.
words.chinese: 瑪雅文明，指古代中美洲的瑪雅民族及其文化。

words.engDef: to be at the airport when someone's plane arrives
words.example: Our airport representative will meet your flight upon arrival and escort you to the hotel.
words.chinese: 在機場接送或與航班同步，確保乘客能按時登機。

words.engDef: the middle of summer, around the longest day
words.example: Many tourists visit Scandinavia during midsummer to experience the long daylight hours.
words.chinese: 仲夏節（北歐傳統節日，通常指 6 月 21 日或 24 日）；夏季中旬

words.engDef: the distance travelled, measured in miles
words.example: The company offers a reimbursement policy for business mileage.
words.chinese: 里程數；行駛距離（通常指車輛的行駛里程）

words.engDef: units of distance, each about 1.6 kilometres
words.example: The delivery service guarantees packages will arrive within 100 miles of the origin point.
words.chinese: 英里，英里數（距離單位，常用於測量長距離）

words.engDef: bags that have not arrived with their owner
words.example: The airline is responsible for compensating passengers for their missing luggage.
words.chinese: 遺失行李；未找到的行李

words.engDef: a state in the western United States
words.example: Our company is considering expanding operations into Montana due to its favorable tax incentives.
words.chinese: 蒙大拿州，美國的一個州名，通常用於指代該州或其地理位置。

words.engDef: a building where Muslims worship
words.example: The Blue Mosque in Istanbul is a magnificent example of Ottoman architecture.
words.chinese: 清真寺

words.engDef: the sick feeling caused by travelling in a vehicle
words.example: Many passengers on the cruise ship suffered from motion sickness during the rough seas.
words.chinese: 暈車症，指因交通工具的晃動或移動而引起的噁心、頭暈等不適感。

words.engDef: very high areas of land with steep sides
words.example: The company is planning a team-building retreat in the mountains to boost employee morale.
words.chinese: 山脈；高聳的丘陵群，通常指具有商業或觀光價值的地區。

words.engDef: the largest city in India
words.example: Our company is exploring expansion opportunities in Mumbai due to its thriving business environment.
words.chinese: 孟買，印度商業重鎮，也是印度最大的城市，經常在商業討論中指代該地區的經濟活動。

words.engDef: buildings where objects of interest are displayed
words.example: Our company is organizing a team-building trip to several museums in the city.
words.chinese: 博物館；美術館，通常用於展示藝術品、歷史文物或科學展覽的機構。

words.engDef: so good or interesting that you should not miss it
words.example: This museum is a must-see attraction for anyone visiting the city.
words.chinese: 必看（的）、不可錯過的（事物或體驗），通常指具有高度推薦價值的事物。

words.engDef: a place open late at night for dancing and drinks
words.example: Our marketing campaign aims to attract a younger demographic to the nightclub.
words.chinese: 夜總會，通常提供音樂、舞蹈和酒精飲料的娛樂場所。

words.engDef: the entertainment available in a place in the evening
words.example: The city is known for its vibrant nightlife, attracting tourists from around the world.
words.chinese: 夜生活，指夜晚的娛樂活動，通常與酒吧、俱樂部、餐廳等場所相關。

words.engDef: a place name; also the plural of Nile
words.example: The company is planning a corporate retreat along the Nile River.
words.chinese: 尼羅斯河（埃及的主要河流）; (比喻) 漫長而艱難的過程

words.engDef: a person who does not arrive for a reservation or booking
words.example: The hotel charges a penalty fee for any no-show bookings on weekends.
words.chinese: 已預訂但未到者

words.engDef: not able to be paid back if you cancel
words.example: The airline ticket is nonrefundable, so please double-check your travel dates before booking.
words.chinese: 不可退費的；無法退還的

words.engDef: a flight that goes straight there without landing
words.example: To save time, I booked a nonstop flight from New York to London.
words.chinese: 直飛航班，不經中途停靠的航班

words.engDef: a country in northern Europe
words.example: Our company is exploring potential partnerships with businesses in Norway.
words.chinese: 挪威，一個位於北歐的國家，以其壯麗的自然景觀和高生活品質聞名。

words.engDef: relating to Norway, its people, or its language
words.example: The company is exploring potential partnerships with Norwegian firms specializing in renewable energy.
words.chinese: 挪威的；挪威人的；挪威語的

words.engDef: quite close to

words.chinese: 離...不遠；距離...很近

words.engDef: a long pole with a flat blade used to row a boat
words.example: The rowing team needs to replace their old oars before the competition.
words.chinese: 槳；划槳

words.engDef: the very large areas of salt water on the earth
words.example: The shipping company is exploring new routes across the oceans to reduce delivery times.
words.chinese: 廣闊的海洋；大洋

words.engDef: the tenth month of the year
words.example: The annual sales conference is scheduled for October 15th.
words.chinese: 十月，一年中的第十個月。

words.engDef: in the water a short distance from land
words.example: The cruise ship anchored just off the shore, allowing passengers to enjoy the scenic view.
words.chinese: 在海岸線附近，但不在海岸線上；離岸

words.engDef: at times when demand is lower and prices cheaper
words.example: The train ticket is cheaper during off-peak hours.
words.chinese: 非尖峰時段；離峰時段（通常指交通、能源或服務的價格較低的時間段）

words.engDef: the part of the year when few tourists travel
words.example: The hotel offers discounted rates during the off-season to attract more visitors.
words.chinese: 淡季；非旅遊旺季

words.engDef: by walking
words.example: Due to the strike, employees are advised to commute to work on foot.
words.chinese: 步行；靠雙腳移動

words.engDef: away from work and travelling for pleasure
words.example: Mr. Smith will be on vacation for two weeks, starting next Monday.
words.chinese: 休假，度假

words.engDef: a ticket for a journey in one direction only
words.example: I need a one-way ticket to New York for tomorrow morning.
words.chinese: 單程票，指只能搭乘一次的車票，通常不允許轉乘或退費。

words.engDef: part of the place name New Orleans
words.example: Our company is considering expanding its operations to New Orleans.
words.chinese: 新奧爾良（美國路易斯安那州的一個城市），通常指位於密西西比河口的該城市。

words.engDef: away from the town where you live or work
words.example: I'm out of town on a business trip next week, so I'm not available to attend the meeting.
words.chinese: 不在本地，前往其他城市或國家旅行或居住。

words.engDef: over the side of a ship into the water
words.example: During the storm, a crate of supplies was washed overboard.
words.chinese: （船隻或飛機上）掉入海中或掉下機艙外；（比喻）失去控制或失去職位。

words.engDef: to accept more reservations than there are places available
words.example: The airline had to offer travel vouchers because they overbooked the flight.
words.chinese: 超額預訂

words.engDef: the shelf above the seats for hand luggage
words.example: Please store your carry-on luggage in the overhead rack for safety during the flight.
words.chinese: 行李架；頭頂置物空間（通常指飛機或火車上的），用於存放乘客的行李。

words.engDef: a road or bridge that crosses above another road
words.example: The new overpass significantly reduced traffic congestion during rush hour.
words.chinese: 高架橋，涵洞（通常指跨越道路或鐵路的橋樑，用於交通疏導）

words.engDef: the problem of too many visitors for a place to cope with
words.example: The city council is considering measures to combat overtourism and preserve its cultural heritage.
words.chinese: 過度旅遊：指特定地點因遊客數量過多，導致環境、社會和經濟系統面臨負面影響的現象。

words.engDef: the largest ocean, between Asia and the Americas
words.example: Our company is expanding its operations into the Pacific region.
words.chinese: 太平洋，指廣闊的海洋，常用於描述遠距離或跨國的業務往來。

words.engDef: the capital city of France
words.example: Our company is planning a business trip to Paris to explore potential partnerships.
words.chinese: 巴黎，法國首都，常指法國的商業中心或歐洲的商業樞紐。

words.engDef: a family name; also a person who parks cars
words.example: The parker will guide you to an available spot near the entrance of the conference center.
words.chinese: 代客泊車員；負責在停車場或大樓入口協助駕駛人停車的工作人員

words.engDef: the leaving of a vehicle in a space for a time
words.example: The hotel offers complimentary parking for all guests.
words.chinese: 停車場；停車行為；停車處

words.engDef: to go past something without stopping
words.example: The delivery truck will pass by the warehouse at approximately 3 PM.
words.chinese: 經過；沿著...而過；略過（不予處理或關注）

words.engDef: people travelling in a vehicle who are not the driver
words.example: The airline announced a delay due to inclement weather, affecting hundreds of passengers.
words.chinese: 乘客；旅客

words.engDef: the paved path at the side of a road
words.example: Construction workers are repairing the pavement after the recent storm.
words.chinese: 人行道；人行步道（通常指用混凝土或石塊鋪設的區域）

words.engDef: people who are walking rather than driving
words.example: The pedestrian crossing is for people on foot to safely cross the street.
words.chinese: 行人；步行者（通常指在道路上行走的個人或群體）

words.engDef: the personal belongings someone carries with them
words.example: Please declare your personal effects at customs upon arrival.
words.chinese: 個人物品，通常指旅行或出差時攜帶的私人物品。

words.engDef: the fuel used in cars, called gasoline in America
words.example: I need to stop at the next station to get some petrol.
words.chinese: 汽油 (主要用於英國英語)

words.engDef: to collect someone or something; also to learn casually
words.example: Could you pick me up at the airport at 6:00 AM tomorrow?
words.chinese: （撿取）拾取；（接）載取；（理解）領悟；（改善）提升

words.engDef: to collect travellers and take them on board
words.example: The taxi driver will pick up passengers from the airport at 6 AM.
words.chinese: 接載乘客；載客

words.engDef: a person who flies an aircraft
words.example: The airline requires all pilots to undergo regular safety training.
words.chinese: 飛行員；駕駛員（通常指飛機或船舶的駕駛員）

words.engDef: people who fly aircraft
words.example: The airline is seeking experienced pilots to expand its international routes.
words.chinese: 飛行員；駕駛員（通常指商用飛機的駕駛員）

words.engDef: a place name
words.example: Our company chose Pinehurst for its annual sales conference due to its excellent golf courses and conference facilities.
words.chinese: 松樹村（美國北卡羅來納州的一個城市，以高爾夫球場聞名，常被用於商務活動或會議場地）

words.engDef: small bags sewn into clothes for carrying things
words.example: He checked his pockets for his wallet before the meeting.
words.chinese: 口袋；（褲子等的）口袋

words.engDef: a country in central Europe
words.example: Our company is exploring potential partnerships with businesses in Poland.
words.chinese: 波蘭，波蘭的（國家名稱或形容詞）

words.engDef: a city in the north-western United States
words.example: Our logistics team is coordinating shipments arriving at Portland International Airport.
words.chinese: 波特蘭（美國俄勒岡州城市），通常指波特蘭國際機場，在商務情境中指代該地區或機場。

words.engDef: a city in north-west England
words.example: Our logistics team is coordinating shipments to Preston and Manchester.
words.chinese: 普雷斯頓 (地名)，通常指英國的普雷斯頓市，在商業情境中可能指該市的企業、地點或相關活動。

words.engDef: a paved public walk, especially beside the sea
words.example: After the conference, attendees enjoyed a leisurely promenade along the beach.
words.chinese: （尤其指在海邊或公園等地方的）散步、閒逛；（正式場合的）遊行

words.engDef: the buses, trains, and other services open to everyone
words.example: The company encourages employees to use public transportation to reduce carbon emissions.
words.chinese: 公共交通系統，指由政府或私人機構運營，向公眾開放的交通工具，如巴士、火車、地鐵等。

words.engDef: to drive a vehicle into a place and stop
words.example: The taxi pulled into the hotel driveway.
words.chinese: 駛入（車輛）；停靠（車輛）

words.engDef: the officer on a ship or plane in charge of accounts and service
words.example: The purser is responsible for all financial transactions and passenger services on board the ship.
words.chinese: 事務長；管事；（船隻、客機等的）座艙長，空服經理

words.engDef: huge stone structures with sloping sides built in ancient Egypt
words.example: The tour guide highlighted the historical significance of the pyramids during the excursion.
words.chinese: 金字塔；（比喻）龐大的組織或系統

words.engDef: the metal track trains run on; also travel by train
words.example: The train was delayed due to a problem with the rails.
words.chinese: 軌道；鐵軌；（比喻）限制、束縛

words.engDef: a thick tropical forest with very heavy rainfall
words.example: The company is committed to sustainable tourism, minimizing the impact on fragile ecosystems like the Amazon rain forest.
words.chinese: 熱帶雨林，指降雨量豐富、植被茂盛的熱帶地區。

words.engDef: a short period of rain
words.example: The meeting was briefly interrupted by a rain shower, but we resumed shortly after.
words.chinese: 短暫的降雨，通常指持續時間較短且強度適中的降雨。

words.engDef: falls as water from the clouds
words.example: The flight has been delayed due to heavy rains in the area.
words.chinese: 降雨；下雨

words.engDef: a person who looks after a park or forest
words.example: The park rangers are responsible for ensuring visitor safety and protecting the wildlife.
words.chinese: 巡邏員；保護員（通常指國家公園或自然保護區的巡邏人員，負責維護秩序、保護生態環境）

words.engDef: a family name
words.example: The law firm will reeve the company in the upcoming legal proceedings.
words.chinese: （尤指律師或法律顧問）代理；代表；辯護

words.engDef: able to be paid back if you cancel
words.example: The hotel offers fully refundable rates, allowing guests to cancel their reservation without penalty.
words.chinese: 可退還的；可以退款的

words.engDef: a car hired for a short period
words.example: The company policy allows employees to use rental cars for business trips.
words.chinese: 租賃汽車；租車服務

words.engDef: to leave on a bicycle, horse, or motorbike
words.example: After the conference, the CEO rode away in a limousine.
words.chinese: 騎離；駛離（某地或某人）

words.engDef: the number of people who use a transport service
words.example: The company is investing in new trains to increase ridership on the subway line.
words.chinese: 客流量；搭乘人數（通常指公共交通工具）

words.engDef: travelling on a horse, bicycle, or in a vehicle
words.example: The company offers employees a subsidy for riding bicycles to work.
words.chinese: 騎乘；騎行（交通工具或動物）

words.engDef: a notice beside a road giving drivers information
words.example: Drivers should pay close attention to road signs to avoid accidents.
words.chinese: 道路標誌；交通標誌，用以指示駕駛者或行人注意安全及遵守交通規則的標誌。

words.engDef: repair work being done on a road
words.example: Due to roadworks on the highway, expect delays of up to 30 minutes.
words.chinese: 道路施工；道路維修工程

words.engDef: to move about a place with no fixed plan
words.example: During the conference break, attendees are free to roam around the exhibition hall.
words.chinese: 漫遊、四處走動（通常沒有特定目的地，用於探索或休閒），在特定區域內自由活動。

words.engDef: a journey to a place and back again
words.example: The company offers a discounted round trip airfare for employees attending the conference.
words.chinese: 往返票；環島旅行

words.engDef: the ways taken to get from one place to another
words.example: The delivery company is exploring new routes to reduce transportation costs.
words.chinese: 路線；航線；途徑

words.engDef: the remains of buildings that have fallen down
words.example: The archaeological team is excavating the ancient ruins to uncover historical artifacts.
words.chinese: 廢墟；殘跡（通常指建築物或城市，暗示過去的繁榮或重要性）

words.engDef: the strip of ground where aircraft take off and land
words.example: The flight was delayed due to runway maintenance.
words.chinese: 跑道，飛機起降用的跑道。

words.engDef: the times of day when traffic is heaviest
words.example: Due to rush hour, the delivery is expected to be delayed by at least an hour.
words.chinese: 交通尖峰時段，通常指上下班期間道路交通擁擠的時間。

words.engDef: a trip to see wild animals in their natural surroundings
words.example: Our company is organizing a corporate safari to boost team morale and foster a sense of adventure.
words.chinese: （非洲）野生動物考察之旅；（引申）深入探索、考察

words.engDef: to travel over water in a boat using sails
words.example: The company is offering a training program for employees to learn how to sail small boats.
words.chinese: 駕駛船隻；航行（船隻）

words.engDef: the capital city of Chile
words.example: Our company is considering expanding its operations to Santiago, Chile.
words.chinese: 聖地牙哥（智利首都）

words.engDef: the day after Friday
words.example: The marketing team will finalize the campaign report on Saturday.
words.chinese: 星期六，週六；通常指週末前的最後一天，在商務情境中可能指週末休假或安排非工作相關活動的日子。

words.engDef: a large flat grassy area in a hot country
words.example: The safari tour company highlighted the unique wildlife found in the African savanna.
words.chinese: （非洲的）稀樹草原；廣闊的草原生態系統

words.engDef: the northern country of the United Kingdom
words.example: Our company is considering expanding its operations into Scotland to tap into the growing tourism market.
words.chinese: 蘇格蘭，一個位於英國北部的國家，以其獨特的文化、風景和傳統而聞名。

words.engDef: the sick feeling caused by the movement of a boat
words.example: Several passengers complained of seasickness during the rough crossing.
words.chinese: 暈船病；因海上旅程引起的噁心、頭暈等不適症狀。

words.engDef: the area beside the sea, especially as a holiday place
words.example: We enjoyed a lovely walk along the seaside.
words.chinese: 海邊; 海濱

words.engDef: the number of people a place can seat
words.example: The conference hall has a seating capacity of 300 attendees.
